notes: Summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B search) evaluating Redwood for reranking layer. Primary ask: robust rerank endpoint + offline scoring for large candidate sets.
Discovery call (2026-02-19) - Owner Samira: Product leader (CTO: Alex Marino) wants Hosted first for quick time-to-value, then Dedicated once POC shows latency/cost wins.
Key metrics: online re-rank latency target 40-120ms (95p) for 10-50 QPS peak; offline scoring throughput need ~50k-150k candidate evaluations/day for nightly re-ranks.
POC scope agreed: 2-week offline run (100k queries, ~10 candidates/query) -> compute NDCG/Recall/Precision; followed by 2-week shadowed traffic on hosted API for latency profiling.
Data: will provide anonymized query logs + human-labeled eval set (approx 8k labels for core verticals). Missing labels for payments & logs — need guidance from SE on sampling strategy.
Model preferences: open to high-quality open models + smaller reranker variant (quantized) for lower cost; want ability to route to stronger model for premium customers.
Routing/fallback: product team needs deterministic fallback to older in-house model when Redwood Dedicated capacity is constrained; ask about multi-variant rollouts and canary config.
Security/compliance: must pass SSO/SAML integration and audit logging; legal asked about data residency for EU customers (plan to use regional routing).
Demo feedback (2026-02-27): liked streaming and explicit rerank endpoint; SE Diego showed offline scoring script and candidate batching — team asked for docs on batching knobs and cache TTLs.
Pricing convo (2026-03-01): concerned about per-token volatility. Asked about committed throughput pricing for Dedicated + burst options. Requested sample pricing for 20 QPS baseline.
Technical notes from SE: need support for offline batch scoring API, export of candidate KV cache, ability to run scoring without full tokenization for faster throughput tests.
Quote from CTO Alex: 'If we can hit parity with current quality and cut per-eval cost by 30% we're ready to move to Dedicated.'

Action items: (1) SE to share batching guide + sample candidate scoring notebook by 3/7; (2) Send Dedicated pricing draft and commitment tiers by 3/9; (3) Security to send SSO integration checklist and SOC2 evidence.
Risks: evaluation relies on label quality and offline eval alignment with live click metrics. Also legal needs clarity on EU residency before Dedicated contract.
